cases.required_behavior: Unknown strategy identity is not passed as the existing Early Leadership control
New source event without accepted B1 anchor stays a nomination, not a surrogate episode
Later source correction preserves earlier source-known decision belief
Historical event discovery reports current-manifest selection limits
Optional absent evidence differs from measured neutral and adverse evidence
Unpromoted model or computational availability cannot grant product trading authority
No parallel outcome/quote/geometry/thesis owner is introduced
Public availability, system capture, model vintage and user visibility remain separate
Actual and expectation with different fiscal periods are not compared as a beat
GAAP and issuer-adjusted values need explicit compatible definition
Currency, units, segment and share basis mismatch is disclosed
Absent/unlicensed consensus does not become zero or a statistical-forecast consensus
Contributor departure can change mean without a matched upward revision
No common contributor yields unmeasured matched revision, not zero
Fixed-period estimate changes are separated from forward-horizon roll
Near-zero/negative expectation does not manufacture a percent beat
Guidance withdrawal/range change is not an ordinary raise/cut scalar
Release, call, filing and later estimate observations use their own known clocks
Post-event revision cannot be substituted for pre-event expectation
Same-event correction does not mint a new independent opportunity
Post-release fill cannot earn the pre-fill announcement gap
Never-confirmed/no-pullback/unpriced events remain in the policy accounting
Next earnings event does not erase original forecast or reset its outcome horizon
Loss in a tactical/earnings trade cannot silently become a Cycle Capture position
Domain readiness is evaluated without selecting on future returns
Broad Census computers/electronics data is not labeled granular semiconductor evidence
Industry/segment membership and classifications are point-in-time or explicitly current-only
Revised industrial series cannot overwrite an original-vintage observation
Lower absolute inventory is distinguished from higher inventory relative to sales
Order cancellations and nominal-price effects are not unqualified demand improvement
Dated debt maturity can breach liquidity before headline cash runway expires
Restricted cash and conditional facilities cannot be assumed fully usable
Operating cash/obligations and financing proceeds are not double-counted
Higher enterprise value with dilution can lower per-share value
Original shares cancelled in restructuring do not inherit new-equity recovery
Joint recovery/funding/payoff is not a product of unverified independent scores
Future-smoothed economic state is excluded from live historical signal claims
Failed/delisted/censored cases and common-cycle dependence are retained
New-add chase refusal does not automatically terminate a valid core hold
Binding structural/funding invalidation cannot be waived by bullish narrative
Earnings drawer shows actual/prior/expectation basis and distinct source clocks
Cycle drawer shows funding milestone, assumptions and original-equity scenario
Uncalibrated forecasts render as unavailable/accruing, not invented probabilities
Watch saves only to selected existing list and verifies actual owner readback
Notes and episode actions are not falsely presented as cloud-persisted
Shared event across sleeves does not duplicate portfolio exposure or independent N
Rights/entitlement restrictions apply to numbers and generated explanations
Accepted source to entitled browser and subsequent ordinary refresh preserve correction/identity truth
